description: Per-area RESIDUAL salience on a 2-D az×el RETINA (the 2-D expansion of Rung 4, closing the 2-D loop after 166000). Salience is the RESIDUAL of the async onset-event stream AFTER the dominant coherent structure is explained -- the surprising cell whose motion is NOT accounted for by the DOMINANT common-fate motion (157000's egomotion-cancelled residual, now event-native AND 2-D). The 1-D retinal_residual_salience reads azimuth only, so a spatially-separated PURELY VERTICAL mover contributes NOTHING to its azimuth-only velocity and is ranked at the BACKGROUND level -- MISSED. The `retinal_residual_salience_2d` Rust task kind reduces events to one mean epoch per firing cell (col,row), groups cells into 8-connected components (the SAME grouping the 2-D carve uses), fits each component's 2-D velocity (v_az,v_el), picks the DOMINANT component (most cells; the coherent background) to define v_dom, and emits a fixed per-cell stride-3 layout [fired, raw_salience=|v_comp|, residual_salience=|v_comp - v_dom|] (the 2-D VECTOR-difference norm) at flat index row*n_az+col. This rule matches every RetinalColumn cell against the done 2-D salience task and mints ONE RetinalSalience node per FIRING cell (output[cell_index*3+0]==1.0) carrying both scores, once per cell-epoch via a salience2d_epoch guard. No threshold on the salience value -- the fovea's log-weighted admissibility grammar decides. OFF by default: the rule cannot fire unless a RetinaSalienceParams2d node exists (created by the adapter only when context['visual_salience'] AND context['retina_2d'] are set), and the adapter creates the 2-D salience task only then. The 1-D retinal_residual_salience kind + retinal_salience seed are byte-untouched.
